question: Using information from End Corporal Punishment, identify the countries that banned all corporal punishment of children between the years 1955 and 2004 (inclusive of bans in the years 1955 and 2004). Of these countries, which had a total mortality rate of children under the age of 5 that decreased by more than three per 1,000 live births between the years 2005 and 2023 according to the World Bank Group?
